name: Baptizing
overview: Scripture clearly teaches that baptizing is an essential act commanded by Christ, as seen in the Great Commission to make disciples of all nations through baptism in the name of the Father, Son, and Holy Spirit (Matthew 28:19). Baptism is closely connected to salvation and repentance, with belief and baptism being necessary for salvation (Mark 16:16) and the remission of sins accompanied by receiving the Holy Spirit (Acts 2:38). Jesus Himself set the example by being baptized, affirming its significance (Luke 3:21), and baptism is described as part of the new birth necessary to enter God's kingdom (John 3:5).
